verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, BS 2567, 1971).

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
This is the original UK December 1971 release in matt gatefold cover, on green Warner Bros. Records labels.
This album has a 'Unipak'-style multi gatefold [disc access from the inside] with only one card layer for the front lap, and includes a detachable folded 1972 calendar.
Green Warner labels without 'Made in UK' or small 'v' on either side.

All songs recorded at RCA, Chicago

℗ 1971

Produced for Nimbus 9 Productions, Ltd.
An Alive Enterprises Production
Mini-moog synthesizer by Moog Music Inc., Williamsville, New York
A Warner Bros Record Distributed By Kinney Record Group Ltd
by Shorewood Packaging Co. Ltd., England.
A Warner Bros. Inc. U.S.A. Recording
